content:
alex: Draft ready for final sweep: https://drive.redwood.com/launch/final-v5. Need: benchmark wording, CTA microcopy, HubSpot wiring and demo-seat rules. Quick checks only pls.

marta: Scanning now. Editorial: remove superlatives, surface demo-seat rules under FAQ, and show 3-step microflow under hero.

sam: Benchmark suggestion: "In mixed chat + long-context tests (avg conv ~700 tokens), Redwood lowered per-token compute by approximately 25-30% vs baseline (run: run_2026_03_30_v2, s3://redwood-evals/2026/03/30/run_v2/metrics.csv)."

kasia: Good to include CSV. Legal prefers a range. Add one-line methodology: hardware parity and normalized per-token compute. I'll sign off after claim checklist filled.

jenni: Webinar: Wed 2026-04-07 09:00 PT, cap 250, ops reserved 50 demo seats. Demand gen asks: enterprise leads get priority window for 36 hours; allocation 2 seats enterprise, 1 for others. Spell this out in FAQ.

oliver: Ops can implement. Paste HubSpot mapping so I can run webhook test.

sam: HubSpot snippet for appendix: ```hubspot_form_id: hs_123456
properties: email->contact.email, company->contact.company, lead_tier->single_select(enterprise,startup,other), campaign->product_launch_apr2026
webhook: https://hooks.redwood.com/hs/launch-announce-2026```

ops-bot: automated-check: webhook reachable, test payload accepted (200 OK).

privacy-bot: auto-scan: only email/company collected. Please confirm retention period and EU routing; recommend include: "EU leads routed to EU HubSpot instance; contact data retained up to 18 months (Privacy confirmation pending)."

marta: CTA variants in doc. Alex, lean towards: "Register to see the product in action and request a demo." Add microcopy: "Requesting a demo does not guarantee a seat; enterprise leads in priority window receive allocation preference."

alex: Will update doc with CSV link, hubspot snippet, microflow, and the CTA line. Timeline: editorial + ops by today EOD, legal + privacy by Mon noon, publish Wed AM. Everyone ack?

jenni: Ack. Will confirm webinar dry run schedule.

sam: Ack. Will paste final benchmark wording and run link by tonight.

kasia: Ack. Will complete claim checklist and chase Privacy on retention.

oliver: Ack. I'll run a live webhook test and paste trace here once done.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: webhook dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT.
